thread:
lina: Putting a draft private offer for HelixGrid x VectorWorks co-sell on Skyward Marketplace. Need quick eyes on renewal escrow, carryover credits, regional HW caps, and SKU parity. @omar @diane pls
omar: Nice. High-level ask: keep entry band simple to reduce legal churn. Propose $45k starter. Also add small POC pool for named accounts.
diane: Finance: propose bands 45k/320k/1.05M with discounts 9%/16%/23%. Renewal mechanic idea: escrowed credits that auto-apply as on-invoice line item at renewal, with carryover up to 6 months if underused. Cap carryover at 20% of next-year invoice. Will run margin impact.
suresh: Sales: add $25k POC bucket for top SI-led pilots and require a 60% usage floor in first 9 months to redeem escrow credits. Also request SKU names to map to Dedicated tiers.
frank: Legal note: appliance credits > $75k require export/customs review + internal export sign-off. Need explicit opt-out window (45 days) and clear "on-invoice" definition. Avoid ambiguous rebate language.
procurement-bot: Reminder: attach cost-model when you post finance numbers (template: https://drive.redwood/po-templates/cost-model).
lina: Draft offer snippet below. Keep comments confined to blockers only.
```
HelixGrid x VectorWorks - Skyward Marketplace Private Offer (draft)
Bands:
- Starter: $45,000 commit -> 9% discount, $25k POC credits (named prospects), 6mo activation window
- Business: $320,000 commit -> 16% discount, 12% escrowed renewal credits (on-invoice), 9mo activation window
- Enterprise: $1,050,000 commit -> 23% discount, 20% escrowed renewal credits (on-invoice), 12mo activation window
Escrow & carryover: renewal credits deposited to an escrow line; auto-applied at renewal as an on-invoice credit; unused credits carry over up to 6 months, capped at 20% of next-year invoice; no cash payout
Carryover bonus: customers that exceed commit by >20% in a year receive a 5% bonus credit applied to next invoice (not refundable)
HW appliance credit: up to $75k per account without export sign-off; >$75k requires export/customs review and exec approval; delivered as invoice credit after deployment and clearance
Regional ops: APAC customers get local-currency SKU option; EU customers use EUR SKU with VAT handling; FX cushion 1.5% for orders < $250k
SKU parity: Starter -> Reserved-Token-Small (public token SKU); Business -> Reserved-RG-Medium; Enterprise -> Reserved-RG-Large + private listing for SI deals
Usage floor: must meet 60% of committed usage in first 9 months to redeem escrow credits; otherwise credits lapse per terms
GTM & announcement: joint case study after 2 paid go-lives; partner-listed SKU appears in Skyward after final signoff; co-marketing fund $40k on Enterprise 12mo commit
```
diane: I'll produce a blended margin table and net effective price by band and attach cost-model. Expect numbers by Thu EOD.
frank: I'll draft export and opt-out wording and a short sample "on-invoice credit" clause. Will post redline tomorrow.
suresh: Please share SKU mapping doc for Dedicated tiers. I'll confirm sales enablement pack and named prospect gating for POC credits.
omar: Can we make the POC credits non-transferable and require a named prospect list? reduces risk.
lina: Agree POC = non-transferable & gated to named prospects. Action items: @diane margin + cost-model, @frank legal redline, @suresh SKU mapping + gating list, @omar confirm named prospect list. Planning partner preview Mon 10am PT.
